title: Transitive JavaScript packages caused high-severity audit failures
symptom: The full validation gate failed on high-severity findings in transitive fast-uri, js-yaml, and nanoid versions.
impact: The architecture change could not pass the repository security gate despite not introducing vulnerable application behavior directly.

root_cause.statement: Existing dependency ranges resolved transitive versions below the available patched releases.

solution_options.description: Pin the affected transitive packages to reviewed patched versions through workspace overrides.
tradeoffs: Requires removal when upstream constraints catch up

solution_options.description: Upgrade every direct parent dependency until each naturally resolves patched transitives.

checks: The separately licensed GitHub dependency-review step was skipped and is not claimed as evidence.

prevention: Run dependency audit before freezing a review commit
Track owner and removal condition for every security override

checks: No credential, personal data, customer identity, raw confidential log, or proprietary payload is present.

requirements: Confirm licenses and compatibility before applying overrides
